State College, Pennsylvania


See: The Penn State Professor Who Can't Get Arrested Gets An Articulate Ally: A Local Editor! and"DEATH TO THE DRUGGIES" A Look at Prohibitionist Rhetoric and Its Consequences by Julian Heicklen

There are more than 1,500 people arrested every day on marijuana charges but a Chemistry professor could’t join them. Julian Heicklen, a 65-year-old Penn State chemistry professor, smoked his first marijuana joint Thursday in front of Penn State police officers. This attracted a crowd of about 50 students and local residents holding "Marijuana Smokeout" signs as he reclined in a lounge chair in front of the university gates.

"I'm not doing it for the marijuana, I'm doing it because we have a right to make free choices," said Heicklen, a member of Centre County's Libertarian Party. Heicklen was prepared to be arrested -- he even had $1,500 bail money with him just in case -- but the police said they had no probable cause to arrest him. A campus police officer said Heicklen was not arrested because police didn't believe he was really smoking marijuana. "There was no evidence that it was a marijuana cigarette," Neff said. "Marijuana gives off a distinct odor, and we did not detect that odor."

(Note: Professor Heiklen is a CHEMISTRY professor, but the cops say that they could tell by the odor that this was not marijuana. It is probably hard for a 65 year old professor to score good weed. Where is skunk when you really need it?)

Actually, selective enforcement is one of the advantages of the police state. If making an arrest or prosecuting a case will make them look bad, they can always walk away and look just and prudent. This may prove that Arnold Bennett was right when he said, "The price of justice is eternal publicity."

The good professor explained, "The real cause I believe in is freedom. I think we're putting too many people in jail for using drugs," he said. "The dumbest thing in the world is to arrest people for using a vegetable." Heicklen said he would return to College Avenue at the same time in two weeks to demonstrate again.
